note: Small private RV park on Hwy 3 at the west edge of Strawberry Point, beside the owners' Lil' Bit of Country Stoves shop; big-rig friendly. Sells nights, weeks and months. Backbone State Park is 4 mi away. --Claude
summary: Private gate passes: $30/night bookable on RoverPass (request to book), working website and phone, Google 4.8 (47 reviews). Confirmed 16 full-hookup 30/50A sites with pull-throughs, showers, laundry and wifi. Season changed year-round -> closed Oct 1-Apr 1 (RoverPass calendar). Not waterfront stands.
flags: PRIVATE GATE pass. Price: $30 a night for a full-hookup back-in or pull-through, quoted by RoverPass for June 2027, no park fee (US$50 gate; no gateway within 40 km). Presence: the operator's own website (lbocrvpark.com, RoverPass-hosted, bookable, phone +1 563-933-2081) and Google Maps 4.8 stars from 47 reviews with the same phone. RV Life price_tier 2.

LONG-STAY five tests pass, though it sells weeks and months ('NO DAILY DEPOSIT. 1/2 WEEKLY OR MONTHLY DEPOSIT.'; 'Extended Stay' tag). (1) $30 is under $50. (2) A single night is sold online with a 1-night minimum; it is request-to-book, but there is no application, lease, waitlist or membership. (3) No minimum over 2 nights. (4) No seasonal/nightly split is posted, so it passes. (5) Not a home community: imagery shows a block of gravel RV pads north of Hwy 3 with RVs on them and no homes on the lots. The website's amenity checklist includes a '55-plus' tag that no policy text repeats. It reads as a checklist item rather than an age rule, so it was not put in the note; a human may want to ask.

SEASON: the stored year_round true (derived from the old note's 'Year-round') is contradicted by the park's RoverPass calendar, which is closed Oct 1-Apr 1 every year, so season is written as 04-02 to 09-30. The old note's 'Year-round' was dropped.
HOOKUPS: the RoverPass rate is tagged only amps_30, but the operator's own text says 'option of 30 or 50 amp' and lists '50 Amps', so electric 50 is kept on the operator's word.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands (a town lot on Hwy 3, no water). PIN: the stored 42.68480,-91.54380 is just south of Hwy 3, ~110 m SSW of the pads (which are at about 42.6858,-91.5431, north of the highway behind the stove shop). Under 250 m, so no move proposed.
